definitions.geometry_miss: Canonical any-label max IoU over all Q600 predictions is < 0.5.
definitions.C_center: Replace predicted cx,cy with this GT cx,cy.
definitions.E_extent: Replace predicted w,h with this GT w,h; this mixes area scale and aspect ratio.
definitions.A_angle: Replace predicted angle with this GT angle.
definitions.all_query_any_label: Max over all Q600 ignoring labels: local geometric existence oracle.
definitions.all_query_same_label: Max over queries whose fixed predicted label equals the GT label.
definitions.fixed_original_same_query: Select original best-IoU same-label query once; reuse it for every counterfactual.
definitions.minimal_repair: Smallest component set crossing IoU 0.5; same-order multiplicity is ambiguous.

limitations: Final-box oracle repairability is not a learnable intervention or AP estimate.
Per-GT maxima can reuse one query for multiple GT; no bipartite matching feasibility is claimed.
No shuffled-GT placebo, image bootstrap, aspect-ratio control, or IoU=0.75 secondary analysis.
Overlapping sufficient repair sets are not additive or causal.
Evaluator reachable and ownership miss are combined in the state sanity count.
